body:
HANDOVER DOCUMENT. Main is green and pushed. A cold successor reads, IN ORDER: docs/CONSTITUTION.md (draft) - AGENTS.md - this summary - docs/adr/ - docs/design/unforgeable-types.md - docs/design/adr-0003-migration-status.md - docs/design/story-text-admission-checklist.md - the open bead list. Article X: the chief's authority rests on the record, not the session; takeover after 2h silence by posted notice with a 15-minute objection window; a returning chief does not automatically resume.

WHAT TONIGHT WAS: one defect class - a measurement we could not make, published as one we made; sign-agnostic, so it flatters on some metrics and penalises on others. FIXED ON MAIN: SignatureProjection substituting 0.0 for five absent components in the flagship score; coherence emitting PERFECT for an empty flow; fidelity's 0.5 cliff (only 2 of 4 units cleared it); route:transition-direction comparing per-level ranks as a global axis (RETIRED); Unranked typed Ineligible instead of Missing(ProviderAbstained); interview publishing observed(0.0) for units OUR pipeline failed to classify; unplaced mass counted as the participant's external detail. THE NUMBER THAT MAKES THE CASE: discourseChronology publishes 0.0468 resting on 25.6% OF THE ROUTE on a curated fixture - two participants could both report it while one rests on 90% and the other 5%.

SECOND CLASS, in progress: a private constructor on a case class is NOT a boundary. 84 such classes, 80 with public fromProduct, 45 guarding real validation. Slice 1 (embed-core) LANDED. Slices 2/3/5/6/7 in flight with owners. Criterion: a promise survives a forge only if some field's type is BOTH unforgeable AND not otherwise obtainable - or the representation cannot express the violation.

OPEN OWNER ITEMS: STORYATLAS4S HAS NO GIT REMOTE (bundle at .backups/, same disk); the PD checklist awaits acceptance; two product requirements disposed with measurements - dynamic zoom is blocked on SurfaceDetail being a GHOST AXIS (three checksums, one representation; ADR 0002 D14a decides where the surface packet lives), story+recall together is entirely absent and inherits the RecallGraph privacy witness and joined-trace identity preconditions.

MACHINE: load 80+, disk 98%, 8 concurrent sbt gates. Serialize gates; delete exports at landing.
